title: Google Pixel 11 Pro review: compact, clever, short on stamina
metaDescription: Our Google Pixel 11 Pro review: the Tensor G6, 50MP main camera, HiLight bar, battery life and whether it is worth $1,099 over the Pixel 10 Pro.
excerpt: The Pixel 11 Pro is a compact flagship with excellent AI features and seven years of updates. Battery life and gaming performance are where it falls short.

verdict.summary: The Pixel 11 Pro is the most refined compact Pixel yet. Its software, camera and seven-year update promise are excellent, and at $1,099 it costs the same as the 256GB Pixel 10 Pro did. But the Tensor G6 trails rival flagship chips, battery life is only average for heavy users, and Pixel 10 Pro owners gain too little to upgrade.

sections.heading: What the Pixel 11 Pro is
sections.body:
Google announced the Pixel 11 series on August 12, 2026, with sales from August 20. The Pixel 11 Pro starts at $1,099 with 12GB of memory and 256GB of storage, the same price as the 256GB Pixel 10 Pro (Digital Trends).

The Pro gets most of this year's new hardware: a 50MP main camera, a brighter Super Actua display, a thinner camera bar and the new HiLight light bar. The base Pixel 11 is a much smaller update (Android Central).

sections.heading: How we tested it
sections.body:
We have not tested the Pixel 11 Pro ourselves. This review brings together the published testing from 91mobiles and Business Today with Google's specifications as reported by Android Central, SQ Magazine and Digital Trends. Every figure on this page names where it came from.

When we get a unit, we will add our own battery, charging and camera results here and update the verdict.

sections.heading: Tensor G6 performance
sections.body:
For context, 91mobiles measured an AnTuTu score of 1,421,232, well behind the vivo X300 Pro and Oppo Find X9 Pro, which both scored over 3.4 million. Business Today found demanding games ran smoothly at first but heated up and slowed down during long sessions.

For everyday use the Tensor G6 is fast enough. Both reviews found apps, animations and multitasking smooth. Google's chips are built for on-device AI and efficiency rather than benchmark wins, and that shows in the numbers.

sections.heading: Camera
sections.body:
91mobiles found the Pixel 11 Pro beat the vivo X300 Pro in daylight with more realistic color and dynamic range, but fell behind in low light. Business Today called the photos sharp and vibrant, with natural but imperfect portrait mode.

The camera remains the main reason to buy a Pixel. The new 50MP main sensor on the Pro brings it closer to the best Android camera phones in good light.

sections.heading: Battery and charging
sections.body:
Google claims more than 30 hours of battery life. 91mobiles measured 17.8 hours in PCMark but only about 6 hours of screen-on time, below the 7 to 8 hours now common on flagships. A full charge at 30W took close to 90 minutes in its test.

Battery life is the Pixel 11 Pro's weakest point. Expect to get through a normal day, but heavy users and gamers should plan to charge before evening.

sections.heading: The HiLight bar
sections.body:
The HiLight bar is a colored ring around the flash that lights up for calls and Gemini sessions while the phone is face down. At launch it cannot show alerts from other apps, which 91mobiles lists as its main limitation. Google says more uses will come in software updates.

The HiLight bar is a nice idea that feels unfinished at launch. Do not buy the phone for it.

sections.heading: Should you buy the Pixel 11 Pro?
sections.body:
Buy it if you want a compact phone with Google's best software and seven years of updates. Skip it if you already own a Pixel 10 Pro or care most about gaming and battery life; 91mobiles says the upgrade from the 10 Pro is hard to justify.

The Pixel 11 Pro is a strong choice if you want a compact phone with the best of Google's software.

alternatives.name: Google Pixel 10 Pro

alternatives.name: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL

faq.q: How much does the Pixel 11 Pro cost?
faq.a: It starts at $1,099 in the US with 12GB of memory and 256GB of storage. Check the Google Store for current prices and deals.

faq.q: How long will the Pixel 11 Pro get updates?
faq.a: Google promises seven years of Android OS and security updates for every Pixel 11 model.
